Retest PARTIAL — 9 Nov 2026 (stays in Backlog)
Environment: staging-desk / staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) + API · admin mahmoud.mahamed1515
Method: screen + API, on a throwaway department (QA RT9 2174 Dept) with its own ticket layout and throwaway fields; all deleted afterwards.

Every item still open on 3 Nov is now built and works. One small gap is left: the default status chosen for a department's layout is not applied to new tickets.

Checked:

  • 10 statuses per department → Ticket Status › "Statuses by department and layout": pick department + layout, "Use only the statuses picked below", default status; saved [PASS]
  • 10 only picked statuses usable → ticket page and new-ticket form offer Open / Escalated / Closed only; API refuses On Hold: "'On Hold' is not one of this layout's statuses: Open, Escalated, Closed." [PASS]
  • 10 default status → default set to Escalated, but the new-ticket form shows "Select" and an API create without a status answers "Status is required." [FAIL]
  • 6 pick-list tools → Add values in bulk ("3 new values. 1 already in the list and skipped."), Sort A–Z, Replace values, Clear all; sorted order saved and shown on the form; a value not in the list is refused [PASS]
  • 7 rounding → Normal / Round off / Round down / Round up + decimal places; Round off, 2 places: 12.345 → 12.35, 7.3449 → 7.34, 1.005 → 1.01 [PASS]
  • 8 lookup options → filter, search by up to 6 fields, pop-up fields, sort, fill fields; filter "Email contains qa.webform" → the picker lists only those 5 contacts [PASS]
  • 12 default value → pre-filled on the new-ticket form and stored when left empty; a typed value is kept [PASS]

Still failing:

  • 10 default status: expected a new ticket in the department to start on the layout's default status (Escalated); actual the form shows "Select" and the API requires a status.

Notes: the API accepts a lookup value outside the lookup filter (the screen picker applies it). The ADVANCED tab says "No advanced configuration available for <field>" above options that are there. Not tested: what happens to a ticket moved onto the layout (fallback to default).
